verdict.rationale: CrewAI's own Flows feature is documented as 'event-driven workflows' that connect tasks and control execution, which gives a first-party basis for actions firing on events. The evidence never shows how users define trigger rules (conditions, listeners, routing) or that external events can automatically start actions. Webhook Streaming is outbound event delivery and the REST kickoff endpoint is manual invocation, so neither counts as event-triggered rules. missing for 10: documented rule/condition definition syntax, external event triggers (e.g. app or system events auto-starting flows), concrete listener/router examples, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Flows allow you to create structured, event-driven workflows. They provide a seamless way to connect multiple tasks, manage state, and control the flow of execution in your AI applications.
providing a robust framework for building sophisticated AI automations
